hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | grep -qE '/(addons|\.godot)/' && { echo 'Blocked: addons/ and .godot/ are third-party/generated — never hand-edit (CLAUDE.md)' >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); case "$f" in *.gd) "$HOME/.local/bin/gdformat" "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; out=$("$HOME/.local/bin/gdlint" "$f" 2>&1) || { echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; };; esac; exit 0
